Corollary
[Limits of broken geodesics] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0473 ↗ lem:chow-iii-h55-broken-geodesic-bound 1. apph:H.56\group Integral curves

If the mesh of partitions $P_k$ tends to zero, a subsequence of $\Gamma (x,P_k)$ converges uniformly on every compact level interval to a path $\Gamma _\infty $.
